description: A second pair of eyes that catches what AI misses. Attach a lesson or storyboard and say "Use Pedagrade to review this course."

interface.longDescription:
Pedagrade is a second pair of eyes that catches what AI misses. It checks your course against sound instructional design while you design it. Built by an instructional designer.

Start here: attach or paste a lesson, storyboard, quiz, or design document and type "Use Pedagrade to review this course." No setup needed. You get a score and a short fix list: wrong answer keys, objectives nothing tests, questions that test less than the objective asks, and practice that's missing, each with the fix written out.

Building a course over several chats? Save its learning objectives once, and Pedagrade checks each lesson, activity, or quiz against them as you go. It keeps the course's progress between chats and tells you what the course still needs next.

Pedagrade's analysis runs on its own private AI, your course is never used to train a model, and every check is saved to your Pedagrade account. Pedagrade also works on the web at app.pedagrade.com and inside Word and Google Docs.

How to use Pedagrade: https://pedagrade.com/setup.html
